cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# The Pokémon Emerald Battle Companion (CODE_PLAN.md). This is a standalone
# Qt project, independent of the pokeemerald ROM build one directory up --
# configure/build it from *this* directory, not the repo root:
#
#   cmake -S helperapp -B helperapp/build
#   cmake --build helperapp/build
#
# config/ holds the runtime-loaded symbol table and struct layout JSON
# (Phase 1.3/1.4, regenerated by ../tools/gen_symbols.py and
# ../tools/gen_struct_layout.py against a built pokeemerald_modern.map).
project(emerald_companion LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets Network)

# Phase 2/3's pure decode/transport layers, with no Qt Widgets or socket
# dependency, so tests/ can link just this and run with no emulator and no
# GUI event loop involved.
add_library(emerald_core STATIC
    src/symboltable.cpp
    src/structlayout.cpp
    src/frameparser.cpp
    src/partydecoder.cpp
    src/decoder.cpp
)
target_include_directories(emerald_core PUBLIC include)
target_link_libraries(emerald_core PUBLIC Qt6::Core Qt6::Network)

add_executable(emerald_companion
    src/main.cpp
    src/memorybridge.cpp
    src/mainwindow.cpp
    # Listed explicitly (not just #included) so AUTOMOC's header scan finds
    # their Q_OBJECT macros -- its same-basename-as-a-.cpp heuristic doesn't
    # reliably match across the include/ vs src/ directory split this
    # project uses.
    include/emerald/mainwindow.h
    include/emerald/memorybridge.h
)
# AUTOMOC needs this target's own include dirs set directly -- it doesn't
# reliably pick up include paths inherited transitively from a PRIVATE-linked
# library when scanning this target's headers for Q_OBJECT.
target_include_directories(emerald_companion PRIVATE include)
target_link_libraries(emerald_companion PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets Qt6::Network emerald_core)
target_compile_definitions(emerald_companion PRIVATE
    EMERALD_CONFIG_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config")

option(EMERALD_BUILD_TESTS "Build helperapp unit tests" ON)
if(EMERALD_BUILD_TESTS)
    enable_testing()
    add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()
